hero.title: E-Bike Rentals & Guided Tours
hero.subtitle: Experience the best of Northern Osaka by bike

waterfall.title: Waterfalls, Mountain Temples & Stunning Views
waterfall.description: Visit {minohFallsLink}, and meet thousands of Darumas at the historic {katsuojiLink}. Pedal though forested mountain roads whilst taking in breathtaking views over Osaka and the surrounding area.

cultural.title: Cultural & Historical Experience
cultural.description: Immerse yourself in Japanese culture and history as you explore ancient temples and shrines. Learn about Buddhist traditions and the significance of these sacred places while enjoying the peaceful mountain setting.

ebike.title: Active Fun Without the Strain
ebike.description: Enjoy an active adventure on high performance e-bikes, that take the strain out of the climbs. Experience the thrill of cycling through mountain roads with stunning views over Osaka.

efficiency.title: Amazing Time Efficiency
efficiency.description: Experience the best of Minoh in just half a day, and without feeling rushed. Our carefully planned routes maximize your time, and beat the crowds to the best spots.

accessibility.title: Easily Accessible from Osaka
accessibility.description: Minoh Cycles is located 10 minutes on foot from Sakurai Station - just 20 minutes by train from Osaka-Umeda. This makes it a great way to escape the city and find nature without a long journey.

bikes.title: High-Quality E-Bikes & Equipment Provided
bikes.description: In contrast to budget e-bikes typically used in city tours, our bikes are built for taking on mountain roads. Every bike is well maintained, and insured under the Japanese TS-Mark scheme. Insurance details here.

cta.title: Ready for Your Adventure?
cta.description: Book your Minoh Falls & Katsuoji bike tour today

comingSoon.title: Coming Soon
comingSoon.bikes: We're preparing detailed information about our bikes and rental options. In the meantime, please refer to our {viatorLink} for details.
comingSoon.about: In the meantime, you can learn more about our tours on our {viatorLink}.

bikesPage.title: Our E-Bikes
bikesPage.subtitle: Choose from our selection of high-quality electric bikes, professionally maintained and fitted for your comfort and safety.
bikesPage.note: Both bikes come with professional fitting, safety helmets, and a comprehensive safety briefing. Perfect for mountain terrain and all fitness levels. Battery life on both bikes is sufficient for multiple trips, so you don't need to worry about running out of power.

toursList.title: Our Tours
toursList.subtitle: Explore Northern Osaka by e-bike with our guided tours

katsuojiMinohFalls.name: Katsuoji & Minoh Falls Half-Day Tour
katsuojiMinohFalls.description: Visit both Katsuoji Temple and the stunning Minoh Falls on this half-day e-bike adventure through forested mountain roads.

katsuojiVisitorCenter.name: Katsuoji & Minoh Visitor Center Tour
katsuojiVisitorCenter.description: Explore Katsuoji Temple and discover the natural history of Minoh at the Visitor Center. Perfect for nature and culture enthusiasts.

satsukiyamaSky.name: Satsukiyama Sky Tour
satsukiyamaSky.description: Challenge yourself with breathtaking mountain views and winding roads on this scenic e-bike tour.

toursList.comingSoonMessage: This tour is currently being developed. Check back soon for more details!

tourDetails.title: Katsuoji & Minoh Falls Half-Day Tour
tourDetails.subtitle: Experience the mountain roads of Minoh by e-bike and visit both Minoh Falls and Katsuoji, the temple of winning. Includes lunch at a locally recommended restaurant.
tourDetails.description: High quality electric-assist bikes for a range of heights and helmets are provided.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: A short welcome and briefing, in which I will explain how to operate the e-bikes and ensure everyone's bikes and helmets are adjusted correctly.

rideToTemple.title: Ride up to Katsuoji
rideToTemple.description: Ride alongside the Hankyu railway line to Minoh Station (2.7km), before entering the forested mountain road and climbing to Katsuoji temple (3.2km).

experienceTemple.title: Experience Katsuoji
experienceTemple.description: Make a leisurely circuit of the temple of winning, Katsuoji. Learn about Japanese Buddhism and take in stunning views of Osaka.

continueToFalls.title: Continue on to Minoh Falls
continueToFalls.description: Descend and then ascend again through the mountain to reach the waterfall.

enjoyFalls.title: Take in Minoh Falls
enjoyFalls.description: Enjoy a well-earned rest and take in the beauty of the waterfall.

returnToSakurai.title: Return to Sakurai
returnToSakurai.description: Reap the reward of the uphill journey and enjoy the scenery as we descend back to Minoh and return to Sakurai.

items.waterNote: A 600ml bottle is provided per bike, but you'll need more in summer
items.backpack: A backpack to hold your things
items.moneyNote: entrance to Katsuoji is included, but you may want extra snacks or souvenirs
